title: Skupski and Harrison win US Open men's doubles title, defeat Puetz and Krawietz 6-4 7-6
dek: Britain's Neal Skupski and American Christian Harrison won the US Open men's doubles title, defeating Tim Puetz and Kevin Krawietz 6-4 7-6 (8-6) without dropping a set. The victory marks their second Grand Slam title as a pairing, after winning the Australian Open in January 2026.
author: The GoCheckMySports Desk
key_fact: Neal Skupski and Christian Harrison won the US Open men's doubles title, defeating Tim Puetz and Kevin Krawietz 6-4 7-6 (8-6) and remaining undefeated through the tournament.
bottom_line: Skupski now holds three men's doubles Grand Slam titles across two partnerships. The Australian Open and US Open wins with Harrison in 2026 mark a reversal of the missed-opportunity narrative that defined his prior attempts at major tournaments.
body: Britain's Neal Skupski and American Christian Harrison won the US Open men's doubles title, defeating Tim Puetz and Kevin Krawietz 6-4 7-6 (8-6), per BBC Sport. The victory marks their second Grand Slam title as a pairing, following their win at the Australian Open in January 2026, according to BBC Sport.

Skupski and Harrison did not drop a single set at the US Open, per BBC Sport. The championship run ended a string of heartbreak for Skupski at the tournament. He reached the US Open final last year alongside Joe Salisbury and missed three championship points before losing, according to BBC Sport. In 2022, Skupski and Wesley Koolhof were beaten in the US Open final, per BBC Sport.

The path to their partnership was shaped by circumstance. Joe Salisbury, Skupski's former partner, later took a break from tennis because of anxiety, which led to Skupski pairing with Harrison, according to BBC Sport.

The match itself turned on a single break. Skupski and Harrison secured what BBC Sport describes as the first and only break of the match in the first set, with Harrison slamming a backhand winner down the line to lead 4-3. The second set required more drama. In the tie-break, Puetz and Krawietz were given a set point when a return clipped the net and wrong-footed Harrison. Skupski sealed victory with a smash at the net after saving that set point, per BBC Sport.

Skupski, speaking after the victory, said per BBC Sport: "I don't know what to say really, I'm still in shock. The speech gets a little bit easier once you've won. Losing twice and having championship points in the final last year was a tough part of my career, but it's amazing what a year does in tennis."

The US Open victory is Skupski's third men's doubles Grand Slam title. He won Wimbledon in 2023 with Wesley Koolhof, per BBC Sport. Beyond doubles, Skupski holds two mixed doubles Grand Slam titles, both at Wimbledon in 2021 and 2022 with American Desirae Krawczyk, according to BBC Sport. After securing the title, Skupski dropped to his knees in celebration before turning to hug Harrison, per BBC Sport.
